# Printable Nepali calendar

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/nepali-calendar/

Generate a printable Bikram Sambat month with Gregorian dates using the bundled BS 2000–2090 month table and available holiday notes.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Print BS 2083 Kartik with its matching October/November 2026 dates and review scoped holiday notes.

## Limits and checks

Verified holiday overlays are limited to BS 2083. Other years show calendar dates without a verified holiday list; community or regional holidays are not universal closures.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
